meta.subject: Geography
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Higher Secondary Second Year Geography, 2024 reprint, English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.question_style: Maximum useful source-grounded bilingual competitive-exam coverage from Unit 1: demography, population distribution and density, density regions, demographic measures and formulae, world population growth, projections and doubling time, population composition, sex ratio, literacy and age-sex pyramids, migration and brain drain, push-pull factors, overpopulation impacts and control measures.
meta.quality_policy: Four-option bilingual MCQs grounded in the supplied English and Tamil Class 12 Geography textbook. Classroom activities and ICT navigation are excluded; examinable concepts, definitions, formulae, country examples, textbook statistics, diagrams and exercise-worthy reasoning are retained.
meta.page_reference_note: page_en and page_ta refer to the printed unit page numbers in the respective textbooks.
